about: Proposed region definition for a detailed map of Sri Lanka, as one region for the whole island. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-LK.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.

codes.why: A bare LK collides with no US code in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py).
codes.alternative: ISO 3166-2:LK provinces LK-1 to LK-9, if finer regions are wanted.
codes.verified: The ISO 3166-2 codes were not checked against the ISO site.

box_source.dataset: Geofabrik sri-lanka.poly (extract clipping polygon, 9 distinct vertices)
box_source.caveat: Loose: includes sea around the island. Recompute a tight box from OCHA COD-AB level 0 when it can be opened.

base_map_and_poi.dataset: OSM extract sri-lanka-latest.osm.pbf (137 MB); gpkg.zip is 357 MB

places.dataset: OSM named places; OCHA COD-AB (levels 0 to 4, Survey Department of Sri Lanka source, updated 2022-08-02)

water.dataset: OSM reservoirs and dams for a first build
water.gap: No government dam or tank inventory with a known licence found; data.gov.lk lists most datasets as License Not Specified (search only).

crops.dataset: ESA WorldCover 2021 (land cover, not crop types)

buildings.dataset: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints or Overture buildings

addresses.gap: Overture's address theme lists 41 countries and Sri Lanka is not among them.

related.pr_35: Adds a Colombo box cut from the same Geofabrik extract.
